summary: Full backend + frontend E2E of Register Management (custom register feature). Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_register_mgmt.py — AuthZ (401 no token, 403 for teacher on GET/POST/PUT), list returns exactly 27 builtins + customs, POST creates custom register with slugified key and seeds starter schema (Date/Particulars/Amount/Remarks), duplicate label (case-insensitive) -> 400, duplicate key -> 400, duplicate builtin key ('admission') -> 400, empty label -> 400, PUT rename label, PUT active toggle false/true, generic /registers/<key> POST/GET/PUT/DELETE work for custom register, CSV + XLSX export work, /audit logs the create action. Regression: /api/registers/admission, /api/dashboard, unknown register still 404, teacher roster all pass. Frontend: sidebar link nav-register-management visible; /settings/registers loads with 27 built-in rows + Add panel; create custom register works; duplicate name shows toast 'A register with this name already exists'; rename works and reflects in list; toggle-active hides register from sidebar and reactivate restores it; new custom register appears under 'Custom Registers' group with data-testid=nav-<key>; RegisterView opens with full toolbar (Register Settings, Audit Log, Excel, PDF, Print, Add New Entry) and starter columns; Add Entry drawer submits successfully ('Entry added' toast, table shows 1 record); Register Settings page loads for custom register; /r/admission and dashboard regression pass. All test artefacts (register_defs, reg_<key> collections, schemas, TEST_ rows) fully cleaned up.

issues: Date field uses browser-default native <input type='date'> picker instead of a shadcn Calendar component (also used across built-in registers). Consistent but flagged per review checklist.

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /register-mgmt/{key} on a built-in key (existing==None path) inserts a NEW row with builtin=True but custom=False. list_register_mgmt() only filters customs on d.get('custom'), so this is fine for list display, but check_register() accepts any key present in register_defs regardless of custom flag — this means creating a def for an unknown key via PUT would silently make it a valid register (dead-code today because PUT requires 404 on unknown, which raises before insert). No exploitable issue but the branch that inserts on non-existing key + non-builtin is unreachable; consider removing for clarity.

GET /register-mgmt returns builtins with label=None unless the admin has explicitly renamed one via PUT — frontend Layout & RegisterManagement fall back to REGISTERS[key].label, which works, but the API contract would be cleaner if the backend returned the default label from a shared registry.

Duplicate detection is by label (case-insensitive) across custom registers only — a custom register may be created with a label that matches a BUILT-IN register's default label (e.g. 'Admission Register') because backend only checks db.register_defs. Frontend RegisterManagement.add() does check against merged list before calling API, so UX-safe, but a curl bypass would allow it. Consider also checking against REGISTERS labels server-side.
server.py has grown to 579 lines — still one module for auth, registers, register-mgmt, teacher, dashboard, cron. Reiterating prior recommendation to split into routers.

No DELETE endpoint for /register-mgmt/{key} — admins can only deactivate, not remove a custom register (defs + reg_<key> collection + register_schemas need manual DB cleanup). Consider adding an admin-only DELETE that drops all three for full lifecycle.
